## Description

Please include a summary of the change, which problem it addresses, and relevant motivation or context.

Fixes # (issue)

## Type of Change

- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Code hardening / refactoring

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's coding conventions and architecture principles
- [ ] I have executed `npm test` and all unit and integration tests pass
- [ ] I have validated plugin manifests via `claude plugin validate plugins/antigravity`
- [ ] I have validated marketplace manifests via `claude plugin validate .claude-plugin/marketplace.json`
- [ ] Sensitive tokens, passwords, and private keys are never committed or exposed
- [ ] Documentation has been updated (both `README.md` and `README.ru.md` if applicable)
